seo.descripcion:
The podium of the most liked videos in Africa this week.

Full countdown, from 10 to 1: https://youtu.be/Uug8lGu6Vk8

Data from the official YouTube API. Synthetic voice narration. #Top10RS #shorts

escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Africa this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Laugh Out Loud, by Brazen Kidd TV, with over 190 thousand likes.
In second place, Por favor comparte con tus amigos, by Mohamed Gamal, with over 282 thousand likes.
And number one: Funniest Fan Chants in Football 😂 Bruno "Rat" Chant, by EltelwanyTV, with over 348 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
